summary: VTEX, a Cayman Islands foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting its second quarter 2026 financial results. The filing details revenue of US$64.4 million (up 9.5% YoY), GMV of US$5.7 billion, and non-GAAP operating income of US$13.8 million. The company repurchased 6.2 million Class A shares at an average price of US$3.76 per share, totaling US$23.2 million under its buyback program. This is a routine earnings release, not a special-situation event. No M&A, strategic review, or activist activity is disclosed. The share buyback is part of an ongoing capital return program but not a distinct special situation warranting classification. What to watch: continued AI-driven growth and margin expansion, plus buyback execution.
